title: Last Food Mile Grant
overview: The Last Food Mile Grant is a one-time funding opportunity offered by Farm to Family, an innovative program of the Michigan Department of Agriculture & Rural Development (MDARD). The aim of this grant is to help producers deliver locally grown foods to Michigan institutions, markets and consumers by developing transportation and distribution infrastructure across Michigan. Eligible applicants must be a Michigan-based farm business or a Michigan-based food business/organization that works directly with Michigan-based farmers. Projects must expand delivery of Michigan grown or produced foods to buyers who will be eating or preparing the food, and establish or expand at least one partnership with another business or organization to address local food distribution challenges regionally or locally. Preference will be given to projects that develop market channels for regenerative agriculture products and projects that allocate at least 80% of the proposed budget to a refrigerated vehicle. Applications are accepted through the MIAgGrants portal until February 6, 2026, at 5pm ET. Show More
